name: curl
vendoring: Complete official release archive, with only the top-level directory renamed to curl. All 4406 regular files byte-identical; no files added, removed, or modified inside the source directory.
source_tree_digest_format: SHA-256 of UTF-8 lines: lowercase file SHA-256 + two ASCII spaces + POSIX relative file path + newline, sorted by relative path. Covers every regular file, rejects extra files.
verification: Official HTTPS release archive acquired with normal certificate verification; SHA-256 pinned locally; full archive/source file-name and byte comparison passed. Detached signature downloaded separately but not independently verified; no PGP verification claim.
build: Offline project-owned sdk/c/build/build-curl-deps.sh, sdk/c/build/curl-cmake/CMakeLists.txt, sdk/c/build/probes/curl-native-probe.c. Static PIC HTTP/HTTPS, native Clang/libc++, same pinned BoringSSL archives as peer engine, no WebSocket conversion.
